subject: Summit Health compliance packaging & implementation-crediting questions
messages:
From: Jane Sullivan <jane.sullivan@summithealth.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@summithealth.com
Date: Mon, 05 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood: HIPAA compliance packaging & pricing questions

Hi Laura,

Thanks for the call last week. Summit Health is preparing a procurement packet and we need a clearer breakdown of how Redwood’s compliance/security addons will be priced and delivered. High level asks:

- We need HIPAA-compliant audit logs with 7-day hot retention and tiered cold retention (90 / 365 days). Please provide per-GB pricing and any monthly baseline.
- KMS/HSM: we need the option to deploy keys in our AWS account (bring-your-own-KMS) and an HSM seat model for keys used in production. Please outline seat pricing vs per-encryption-call pricing and any minimums.
- Data residency: production instances in us-east-1, but evidence (attestations/SOC artifacts) must be available to our security team in-region. Clarify evidence delivery cadence and any associated fees.
- Implementation vs ongoing: we’d like to understand one-time implementation / onboarding fees and whether they can be amortized into monthly credits. If so, what cadence and what triggers release of credits?

Deliverables requested: a concise quote with one-time vs recurring breakout, an example statement of work (SOW) draft, and a short mutual action plan that lists milestones (P0: pilot, P1: production cutover, P2: evidence delivery).

Can you get a draft quote and SOW to us by Friday? We’re targeting a procurement review the following week.

Thanks,
Jane Sullivan
Director, Procurement
Summit Health

Attachment: summit_requirements_v1.xlsx (referenced)

From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: Jane Sullivan <jane.sullivan@summithealth.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 06 Apr 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood: HIPAA compliance packaging & pricing questions

Hi Jane — appreciated the clear list. I’m looping in Ben (pricing/commercial) and Marissa (solutions/onboarding) so we can deliver a compact package. Below is a concise proposal and the tradeoffs so procurement can make a decision quickly. I’ll attach a tailored workbook and a first-pass SOW.

Proposal (high level) — three packaging options:

1) Pilot Bundle (6 months)
- Audit logging: 7-day hot included; cold retention 90 days at $0.06/GB-mo
- KMS: BYOK support included; HSM: optional seat at $4,500/mo (minimum 3 months)
- Implementation: one-time $18,000 (setup + attestation prep) — can be 6-month amortization as monthly credits ($3,000/mo) if committed to a 12-mo hosted usage min

2) Production Bundle (recommended)
- Audit logging: 7-day hot baseline + 365-day cold at $0.04/GB-mo after first 90 days
- HSM: seat model $3,900/mo (annual commit) or per-encrypt pricing $0.00012/encrypt-call with 500k monthly included requests
- Implementation: $35,000 one-time. Option to amortize over 12–24 months; see crediting rules below.

3) Enterprise Sovereign (full residency + evidence SLA)
- Audit logging: custom retention tiers + dedicated ingest pipeline; pricing by capacity (example: $0.03/GB-mo with minimum throughput)
- HSM: dedicated HSM cluster pricing; seat discount available with 36-mo commitment
- Evidence delivery: quarterly packaged attestations included; accelerated delivery (within 14 days) available for a one-time evidence-prep fee

Crediting / amortization rules (examples):
- Implementation fee can be converted to monthly account credits applied to invoices if customer provides signed commitment (12mo+). Credits release on production cutover milestone (P1) at 50% and 50% at successful evidence delivery (P2).
- If customer cancels before P1, credits are void.

Attachments I’m sending: tailored workbook (redwood_residency-options.xlsx), draft SOW (draft_sow_summit_20270409.docx), and a short evidence checklist (summit_evidence_requirements.pdf).

Next steps: Ben/Marissa — can you review the pricing knobs and advise on a concession framework? Jane — are you available Friday 11am ET for a 30-min run-through?

Best,
Laura Bennett
Senior Director, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_residency-options.xlsx, draft_sow_summit_20270409.docx, summit_evidence_requirements.pdf

From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 07 Apr 2027 08:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood: HIPAA compliance packaging & pricing questions

Laura — quick commercial guidance from my side:
- If Summit will commit 36 months on Enterprise Sovereign, we can offer a 15% discount on HSM seat pricing (apply to published seat rate).
- For Production Bundle implementation fee, propose a 20% credit back tied to evidence milestones (10% on evidence draft delivery, 10% on final attestation). That helps procurement approve capex versus opex treatment.
- Recommend we include a clause: one-time evidence-prep fee refundable pro-rata if they scale above a throughput threshold in 6 months.

I’ll draft a short concession sheet to include in the quote. —Ben

From: Jane Sullivan <jane.sullivan@summithealth.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@summithealth.com
Date: Fri, 09 Apr 2027 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood: HIPAA compliance packaging & pricing questions

Laura / team — thanks for the fast turnaround and the attachments. A few follow-ups before we proceed to procurement review: 

1) Can you produce a single-page formal quote (PDF) that shows one-time vs recurring and the amortized-credit math side-by-side? We need that in the packet.
2) We need the SOW to call out evidence delivery artifacts (list the logs, SOC pages, KMS attestation steps and expected delivery windows). Can Marissa incorporate our internal audit checklist?
3) DocuSign: please include a DocuSign-ready quote and the SOW for signature routing to contracts@summithealth.com.

On the pricing: the HSM seat discount looks reasonable with a 36-mo commit, but procurement wants the amortization example explicitly (what happens if we change region or cut capacity). Please include cancellation/transfer language.

If you can get the PDF quote + DocuSign bundle and updated SOW by Monday EOD, we’ll include it in the Q2 procurement packet.

Thanks,
Jane
Director, Procurement
Summit Health

Requested attachments: formal_quote_summit_20270409.pdf (to be delivered)
